title: Figure 1: Biomaterial applications in medical devices (photo montage of six implants)
description: Six-panel photo montage captioned "Figure 1. Biomaterial Applications in Medical Devices". Panels show a silicone rubber finger joint, a silicone breast implant (shell/filler labels), a polyester and stainless steel heart valve, an X-ray of a titanium hip joint, a polyurethane and metal artificial heart, and a poly(methyl methacrylate) intraocular lens (IOL). It illustrates the introduction to a 'Biomaterials' report.
